notes: Sign catalogue for the LL bank, lessons and SignSnap (closed IDs). Meanings follow the IRC:67 families (mandatory: circles, red border = prohibition, blue = compulsory; stop octagon; give-way inverted triangle; cautionary: red-bordered triangles; informatory: rectangles), markings follow IRC:35, signals the MV (Driving) Regulations; none of these texts has been fetched and checked yet, so every sign is verified=false and needs the two-person check against the standard (CURRICULUM §2.1 review needs). check_note lists drawing details to confirm. Assets are vectors we still have to draw. SIGN-MAN-016 is intentionally unused (a height-limit sign was dropped until its IRC:67 drawing is confirmed).

alt.hi: ट्रैफ़िक लाइट, लाल बत्ती जली हुई और उसके पास बाईं ओर इशारा करता हरा तीर जला हुआ

meaning.en: You may go only in the arrow's direction, giving way to pedestrians and other traffic.
meaning.hi: सिर्फ़ तीर की दिशा में जा सकते हैं, पैदल यात्रियों और दूसरे ट्रैफ़िक को रास्ता देते हुए।

sources.title: Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations 2017, traffic signals (gazette text not fetched; regulation to pin)
